description: §7.3.3 / §18.7 (S479) — a value `match` arm whose pattern binds the same name twice (`.Loaded(n, n) :> n`) SHALL be E-SCOPE-REDECLARE. Without the rule the second binder silently shadows the first and the arm reads the wrong field.
rationale: §7.3.3 (S479): "a binder that repeats an earlier binder of the SAME arm is E-SCOPE-REDECLARE, reported at the repeat, wherever the `match` stands" (§18.7). Newly-rejecting on the bootstrap (it compiled the arm, the last binder winning). impl#1 fails the case closed with E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC instead of this code (carried, S471 policy).

codes: severity:code 'E-SCOPE-REDECLARE' did not fire (expected severity error)
